svg.title: Calibration strategies for spatial-stochastic biochemical models
svg.desc: Illustrative comparison of three calibration strategies. Panel A: a parameter vector enters a stochastic simulator and produces model output; the likelihood is intractable. Panel B: direct optimization returns a selected parameter vector. Panel C: an optimization prior is updated with observational data to give a data-updated parameter distribution. Panel D: neural posterior estimation returns a conditional parameter density, assessed by predictive and calibration checks. Every panel is a conceptual illustration.
